Theorem conditions, equality cases and zero-information boundaries are explicit.

value.rationale: A scalar measurement of each independent coordinate yields zero conditional area information if simultaneous, making asynchronous placement a natural minimal nontrivial sensing architecture. The global theorem optimizes both temporal separation and unequal potential precision allocation at every budget, proves a strict equal-allocation law, and identifies an exact limiting information ceiling below 9% for all such point designs. This is a complete natural resource-constrained classification relevant to sparse numerical stochastic-area recovery, not an arbitrary numeric slice.
